title: LLM 使用者端偏誤研究：四層威脅模型與框架反轉 (insight_v3 + 三篇公開文章)
abstract_or_snippet: Three-stage first-hand empirical study (90 cloud cells + 16 multi-turn convs) on DeepSeek-R1/Qwen3/GLM-4 over the 228 Incident. KILLER FINDING: abliterated models PRODUCE Taiwan-mainstream historiography while vanilla refuse/insert CCP framing in the thinking-chain — proving the model KNOWS but is post-trained not to say. DeepSeek refuses on identity disclosure; framing is post-training/RLHF, not corpus absence. Four-layer model: platform refusal / weight-alignment framing / base capability (abliteration) / conversation layer.

title: State media control influences large language models
author_or_org: Waight, Yang, Yuan, Messing, Roberts, Stewart, Tucker (Nature)
abstract_or_snippet: Six studies. Cross-national audit (37 countries): LLMs show stronger pro-government valence in languages of lower-press-freedom countries — abstract explicitly states 'This result is correlational'. CAUSAL mechanism established ONLY at model level via continued pretraining: Llama-2-13b + 6,400 state-media docs -> ~80% pro-government responses. Makes NO user-belief-change claim; cites prior persuasion work only as background, measures model OUTPUT valence only.
why_relevant: L3: the anchor Nature paper — confirmed CORRELATIONAL at population level, CAUSAL only at model output via pretraining; explicitly does NOT cross into L4b/L4c user persuasion.
search_query: state media training data language model biased output

title: Large language models reflect the ideology of their creators
author_or_org: Buyl, Rogiers, Noels et al. (npj Artificial Intelligence; arXiv preprint)
abstract_or_snippet: Prompted 19 popular LLMs to describe 3,991 politically relevant persons. Finds ideological disparities ACROSS geopolitical regions (Arabic, China, Russia, Western) and across the UN's six languages, AND between internationally- vs domestically-focused Chinese models. Tests Western AND Chinese models symmetrically.
why_relevant: L3 SYMMETRIC TEST: the operator-required Western-model evidence — Western models also carry measurable ideological lean, so 'Chinese=biased' is a directional artifact unless tested both ways. This tests both.
